about: Script functions the xml2-fix dinput.dll registers (research/heroes/FORCED_TEAMS_DESIGN.md 1.2; SPEC 19; addSkillPoints: SPEC 32; addStatPoints: SPEC 48). They exist only when xml2-fix's forced_teams module is installed and [Game] ForcedTeams is present in xml2-fix.ini (registration: extended copy of the table at 0x68a908, push operands 0x49fe31 / 0x49fe36). xml1build merges them into the XMen2.exe API (xml2_api.json) for --forced-teams seat builds, and the ones in common.XML2FIX_ALWAYS_FUNCS (addSkillPoints/addStatPoints, called from pickup data) into every build's; validate V14a cross-checks these entries against scripts_transform.XML2FIX_API.
xml2fix: forced_teams module, planned xml2-fix 1.3.2 (addSkillPoints since 1.3.0; addStatPoints since 1.3.2)
